## Statement

Reeh and Schlieder (1961) study the unitary equivalence of Lorentz-invariant fields and obtain what is cited as the Reeh-Schlieder property: for a positive-energy, Poincare covariant theory with a vacuum vector, the vacuum is cyclic for the algebra of any bounded open region. The paper is in German and the checkout holds no copy; the statement and hypotheses are recorded from citations.

Record only. The precise hypotheses (spectrum condition, vacuum uniqueness, covariance) are to be audited against the paper.
